title: Selection
description: A lyric paragraph on pale grey with an iPhone text selection: blue handles, a pale blue highlight and a black “hello there!” tooltip. Drag a handle and the whole page tips back toward a vanishing point while the selected lines lift off it in real perspective, each highlight bar turning in depth with its handles and casting a soft shadow, and little italic ones and zeros tumble off the ends toward you; let go and it all settles flat, the tooltip turns into Copy, Look Up and Share, and Copy folds the highlight down into a copied pill.
intent: The text-selection UI itself as the graphic: a familiar control given depth and weight, so selecting words physically pulls them off the page, with every morph clean and nothing overlapping.
